### Bible Pathways 8/19/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-8-or-19-or-2001-719400.html
Passage: Jeremiah 20:6
Points:
- Jeremiah boldly declared God's coming judgment against Pashhur despite suffering beating and imprisonment at his hands.
- Holding an official religious title or high temple office does not make a person truly godly.
- Faithful messengers often experience intense discouragement and feel like failures when their message is rejected.
- Remaining obedient to God's Word is never a failure in the eyes of the Lord.
